page: Microsoft Azure NC64as_T4_v3 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine belonging to the NCASv3_T4 family. It features an x86_64 AMD processor with 64 dedicated vCPUs managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The system is equipped with 440.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 6.88 GB of RAM per core.

For accelerated workloads, this server integrates four NVIDIA T4 GPUs, delivering a combined total of 60 GB of VRAM. Storage capabilities include 2884 GB of local storage, and the instance is Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-performance disk configurations. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

This hardware profile offers a balanced allocation of compute, memory, and GPU resources. The inclusion of multiple NVIDIA T4 GPUs makes it suitable for workloads such as machine learning inference, video transcoding, and graphics rendering. The dedicated AMD CPU cores and substantial memory footprint support parallel processing tasks, database hosting, and analytical workloads that benefit from GPU acceleration.
